label: TP
reason: User-supplied parameter name flows directly into the SQL query via ThingFactory.createThing().doSomething(), which constructs a dynamic WHERE clause ('WHERE ' + param + '= ...'). The resulting SQL string is used in JDBCtemplate.queryForList() without proper escaping/sanitization of the variable portion, allowing attackers to inject arbitrary SQL syntax.

evidence.note: Parameter name extracted from request and passed to helper function
Dynamic SQL construction concatenates user input directly into query string
